details: World developers seeking to create complex worlds that handle arrays could greatly improve their development process if they were able to use Generic Collections, especially List<T>. It would be even more helpful if we could also use C# LINQ operations. There are many common situations where Collections and LINQ combined can reduce large quantities of code to simple one-line or one-operation solutions.
title: Expose C# Generic Collections (List<T>, Dictionary<TKey,TValue>, etc.)
